actual_triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER a_first AFTER INSERT ON gt_later_wait.check_then_wait DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION gt_later_wait.check_deadline()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER z_second AFTER INSERT ON gt_later_wait.check_then_wait DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION gt_later_wait.wait_lock()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER a_first AFTER INSERT ON gt_later_wait.wait_then_check DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION gt_later_wait.wait_lock()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER z_second AFTER INSERT ON gt_later_wait.wait_then_check DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION gt_later_wait.check_deadline()

limitations: Synthetic trusted test schema, not an original product exploit or execution authority
Decision check before a later blocking deferred trigger does not guarantee deadline at commit completion
Ordering the check last in this controlled two-trigger case rejects expiration; whole product queue/locks/end channels remain pending
No statement about WAL flush or remote commit acknowledgement deadline; no Source/JWT/Intent/budget/product change
